rationale: The new task closely matches lockfile-auditor: Guion already handles SemVer bounds, denials, date-based exceptions, deterministic diagnostic ordering, and atomic JSON output. Python’s reference is shorter, but both passed the frozen cases and Guion’s measured case time was substantially lower.
trial_observation: The exact acceptance command returned total=17, guion=17, python=17; the result confirms all 17 cases passed in both implementations, including version boundaries, malformed input, and exception cases. For the named lockfile-auditor-policy-report case, the seven-pair measurements include oracle-check time: median elapsed time was 16.369 ms for Guion and 94.047 ms for Python; the median paired ratio was 0.1693 (95% bootstrap interval 0.1622–0.1734).
